Kahleah Copper has cleared 13+ points in 90% of her 41 games this season, and is riding a 11-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 100% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 20.7 points on the season (25.8 across her last 5) — the 13+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -650 at Fanatics.

Angel Reese has cleared 11+ points in 79% of her 43 games this season, and is riding a 8-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 15.7 points on the season (20.6 across her last 5) — the 11+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -650 at Fanatics.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -302 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
